import json
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":8,"var":"data,size","code":"hb_blob_create((const char *)data, size, HB_MEMORY_MODE_READONLY, NULL, NULL)","note":"The fuzzer input bytes are wrapped as an hb_blob_t, so attacker-controlled font data becomes the face backing store."},
  {"step":2,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":9,"var":"blob","code":"hb_face_create(blob, 0)","note":"The blob is turned into an hb_face_t, causing HarfBuzz to parse the supplied font tables on demand."},
  {"step":3,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":10,"var":"face","code":"hb_font_create(face); hb_ot_font_set_funcs(font)","note":"A font object is created from the attacker-controlled face and configured to use OpenType/CFF font callbacks."},
  {"step":4,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":27,"var":"text32[15]","code":"test_face(face, text32[15])","note":"The fuzz input also supplies a codepoint argument into the helper that exercises many font APIs, including glyph extents."},
  {"step":5,"file":"test/api/test-ot-face.c","function":"test_face","line":45,"var":"hb_font_get_glyph_extents(font, cp, &extents)","code":"hb_font_get_glyph_extents(font, cp, &extents)","note":"This API dispatches into the CFF glyph extents implementation for the selected glyph."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/hb-ot-cff1-table.cc","function":"OT::cff1::accelerator_t::get_extents","line":308,"var":"glyph","code":"_get_bounds(this, glyph, bounds)","note":"The extents routine asks the CFF accelerator to interpret the glyph's charstring and compute bounds."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/hb-ot-cff1-table.cc","function":"_get_bounds","line":318,"var":"str","code":"const ByteStr str = (*cff->charStrings)[glyph]","note":"The glyph's raw CFF charstring bytes are fetched from the attacker-controlled font data."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/hb-ot-cff1-table.cc","function":"_get_bounds","line":319,"var":"interp.env","code":"interp.env.init(str, *cff, fd)","note":"The interpreter environment is initialized with the raw charstring and the font's subroutine dictionaries."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/hb-cff1-interp-cs.hh","function":"CFF1CSOpSet::process_op","line":96,"var":"OpCode_endchar","code":"if (env.argStack.get_count() >= 4) OPSET::process_seac(env, param)","note":"A Type 1 seac-style endchar path is taken when the charstring leaves four or more arguments on the stack."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/hb-ot-cff1-table.cc","function":"CFF1CSOpSet_Extents::process_seac","line":270,"var":"env.argStack","code":"delta.x = env.argStack[n-4]; delta.y = env.argStack[n-3]; base = std_code_to_glyph(...); accent = std_code_to_glyph(...)","note":"The seac handler reads stack values derived from the charstring and resolves base/accent glyphs from font encoding tables."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src/hb-ot-cff1-table.cc","function":"CFF1CSOpSet_Extents::process_seac","line":275,"var":"base_bounds, accent_bounds","code":"_get_bounds(param.cff, base, base_bounds, true) && _get_bounds(param.cff, accent, accent_bounds, true)","note":"The handler recursively computes bounds for the referenced glyphs, propagating the attacker-controlled charstring state into nested interpretation."},
  {"step":12,"file":"src/hb-ot-cff1-table.cc","function":"CFF1CSOpSet_Extents::process_seac","line":279,"var":"param.bounds","code":"param.bounds.merge(base_bounds); accent_bounds.offset(delta); param.bounds.merge(accent_bounds)","note":"The computed bounds are merged into the output extents; the vulnerability hypothesis is that malformed seac/charstring state can drive uninitialized values into this merge path and crash under MSAN."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('trace written')
